rationale: A real-data run must not promote itself to a scientific claim. This record is consumed by p22.eval.real_paired_acceptance and binds the declared representation, count unit, ordered identities, per-fold donor provenance and protocol settings to the executable configuration before any corrected run is promoted.
preserved_historical_result: docs/repeated_internal_comparison_2026-09-21.json is unchanged; the old inputs violate this contract and are preserved only as exploratory history.

atac.interval_rule: a fragment record qualifies for region [beg, end) when fragment_start < end and fragment_end > beg; fragment_start >= fragment_end records are ignored

regions.rule: per outer fold, top-256 exact intervals by that fold's training-library prevalence; ties broken by (chromosome, start, end)

population.retained_population: H5AD retained set; unknown barcodes are refused, never silently dropped

protocol.margin_rule: practical_margin(15, 15); not lowered after seeing results

manifest.note: generated after the corrected ATAC matrices are measured; until it exists no real run may set scientific_claim_allowed
